title: Agglutinate
summary: AGGLU'TINATE, verb transitive [Lat. agglutino, ad and glutino, from gluten. Eng. glue. See Glue.] To unite, or cause to adhere, as with glue or other viscous substance; to unite by causing an adhesion

inlines.v: AGGLU'TINATE, verb transitive [Lat. agglutino, ad and glutino, from gluten. Eng. glue. See Glue.] To unite, or cause to adhere, as with glue or other viscous substance; to unite by causing an adhesion of substances.
